meta.name: pinme-r2
meta.description: Use when a PinMe Cloudflare Worker needs R2 object storage, including secure file or image upload, streaming download, metadata lookup, deletion, listing, Range requests, or R2+D1 coordination. Guides AI to use PinMe's automatically injected env.R2 binding without R2 credentials or manual Wrangler configuration.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用R2对象存储安全上传、下载和管理文件
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Cloudflare Workers中操作R2存储
copy.tagline_en: Securely upload, download, and manage files with R2 object storage
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to operate R2 storage in Cloudflare Workers

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会使用 PinMe 自动注入的 R2 存储桶来安全上传、下载、删除、列出文件，并支持流式传输和范围请求。
howto.when: 当需要为 PinMe Cloudflare Worker 实现 R2 对象存储功能时触发，例如文件上传、下载、元数据查询、删除、列表或 R2 与 D1 协调。

say.text: 帮我写一个上传文件的 Worker 路由。
say.note: Claude 会生成使用 env.R2 的流式上传代码。

say.text: 添加一个下载文件的接口，支持 Range 请求。
say.note: Claude 会生成流式下载并处理 Range 头的代码。

say.text: 列出当前用户的所有文件。
say.note: Claude 会生成按用户前缀分页的列表代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude will use the PinMe-injected R2 bucket to securely upload, download, delete, and list files, supporting streaming and Range requests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when a PinMe Cloudflare Worker needs R2 object storage, such as file upload, download, metadata lookup, deletion, listing, or R2+D1 coordination.

say_en.text: Write a Worker route to upload a file.
say_en.note: Claude generates streaming upload code using env.R2.

say_en.text: Add a download endpoint supporting Range requests.
say_en.note: Claude generates streaming download with Range header handling.

say_en.text: List all files for the current user.
say_en.note: Claude generates paginated list code scoped to the user prefix.
